command:
set -u
mkdir -p r07-proof
setup_rc=0
(cd runtime && python -m pip install -e '.[test]') > r07-proof/setup.log 2>&1 || setup_rc=$?
collection_rc=99
focused_rc=99
if [ "$setup_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  collection_rc=0
  (cd runtime && python -m pytest --collect-only -q tests/test_contract_fixtures.py tests/test_update_jobs.py) > r07-proof/collection.log 2>&1 || collection_rc=$?
  if [ -f r07-proof/collection.log ]; then
    awk '/^tests\/test_contract_fixtures\.py::/ { fixtures++ } /^tests\/test_update_jobs\.py::/ { updates++ } END { printf "tests/test_contract_fixtures.py: %d collected\ntests/test_update_jobs.py: %d collected\ntotal: %d collected\n", fixtures, updates, fixtures+updates }' r07-proof/collection.log > r07-proof/coverage.txt
  fi
  focused_rc=0
  (cd runtime && python -m pytest -q tests/test_contract_fixtures.py tests/test_update_jobs.py) > r07-proof/focused.log 2>&1 || focused_rc=$?
fi
printf 'setup=%s\ncollect_only=%s\npytest=%s\n' "$setup_rc" "$collection_rc" "$focused_rc" > r07-proof/inner-exits.txt
cat r07-proof/setup.log
cat r07-proof/collection.log 2>/dev/null || true
cat r07-proof/focused.log 2>/dev/null || true
cat r07-proof/coverage.txt 2>/dev/null || true
cat r07-proof/inner-exits.txt
test "$setup_rc" -eq 0 && test "$collection_rc" -eq 0 && test "$focused_rc" -eq 0
